variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.
variants.body:
The company {company} has laid off many workers. The scale is described as large, but a specific number is not supplied here. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish the loss of jobs from an invented cause, severance arrangement or account of what will happen to those affected.

Our politics should have something serious to say about people losing work. A principle that matters only when an economy is comfortable is a thin principle. The question of responsibility deserves attention without turning affected workers into scenery for an argument about a cause that has not been established.

We support {target} against a blanket adverse verdict. The layoff is serious, but the report does not establish every claim about its causes or prove that a particular imagined alternative was available. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
